transcript: The other night, my friend Madison and I went to the Encores production of Once Upon a Mattress and it was kind of a pleasant surprise. That’s not to say I had low expectations, but I just never seen a production of this show before and so I figured maybe it's not frequently produced for a reason. But this was super fun, I mean it was funny, well-paced and the orchestra sounded amazing. The story itself was kind of super random, with a plot that can literally be explained in one song, but this show was a great vehicle for this cast. Sutton Foster is obviously great, she seems so comfortable in this role and she really knows how to ham it up with the physical comedy, but really the entire cast is doing a great job. This production of Once Upon a Mattress is currently running at New York City Center for only another week so act fast if you wanna be there. With that, another program for my collection
